images.title: Rectangle 7 by 4
images.purpose: Show the finished rectangle ABCD with AB 7 cm and BC 4 cm and all angles 90 degrees.
images.composition: One wide rectangle centred on white space with four right-angle marks and two length labels.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle ABCD, outline teal #0072B2. A bottom left, B bottom right, C top right, D top left. Width AB exactly 7 units and height BC exactly 4 units, in the ratio 7 to 4. Right-angle marks at all 4 corners. Bottom side labelled 7 cm and right side labelled 4 cm. Exactly 1 rectangle, 4 right-angle marks, 2 length labels.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a slanted four-sided figure, or a rectangle not in the ratio 7 to 4
images.takeaway: A rectangle has four right angles and equal opposite sides.
images.description: Rectangle ABCD, 7 cm wide and 4 cm tall, with right-angle marks at every corner.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to read the two lengths and name the four right angles.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
